answer: Give every agent a work pulse: once per epoch it must solve a fresh task derived from the beacon seed, and the result is checked by a randomly drawn panel of peers. The kernel of the defense is that only identities with an unbroken pulse over the last five epochs may vote or grade, so a sybil farm must pay real compute for every fake account, every epoch. Graders also stamp answers with a pigment-like fingerprint of style, and clusters of near-identical answers get their weight split instead of multiplied.
